name: Node.js Application
author: SOURAJITVFX
description: Node.js application egg with selectable Node runtime images, npm dependencies, uploaded files or Git deployment, and JavaScript/TypeScript entrypoints.
startup:
cd /home/container
set -e
if [ -d .git ] && [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = "1" ]; then git pull --ff-only; fi
if [ -n "{{NODE_PACKAGES}}" ]; then npm install {{NODE_PACKAGES}}; fi
if [ -n "{{UNNODE_PACKAGES}}" ]; then npm uninstall {{UNNODE_PACKAGES}}; fi
if [ -f package.json ]; then if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --omit=dev; else npm install --omit=dev; fi; fi
if [ ! -f "{{MAIN_FILE}}" ]; then echo "ERROR: Main file '{{MAIN_FILE}}' was not found."; exit 1; fi
case "{{MAIN_FILE}}" in
  *.js|*.mjs|*.cjs) exec node "{{MAIN_FILE}}" {{NODE_ARGS}} ;;
  *.ts|*.mts|*.cts) if [ -x node_modules/.bin/tsx ]; then exec node_modules/.bin/tsx "{{MAIN_FILE}}" {{NODE_ARGS}}; elif [ -x node_modules/.bin/ts-node ]; then exec node_modules/.bin/ts-node "{{MAIN_FILE}}" {{NODE_ARGS}}; else echo "ERROR: TypeScript selected but tsx/ts-node is not installed in package.json."; exit 1; fi ;;
  *) exec node "{{MAIN_FILE}}" {{NODE_ARGS}} ;;
esac

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 python3-dev python3-pip libtool
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [[ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" == "1" || "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" == "true" ]]; then echo "Upload mode: skipping Git clone."; exit 0; fi
if [[ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]]; then echo "No Git repository set; use uploaded files."; exit 0; fi
REPO="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
if [[ "${REPO}" != *.git ]]; then REPO="${REPO}.git"; fi
if [[ -n "${USERNAME:-}" && -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then HOST_PATH="${REPO#https://}"; HOST_PATH="${HOST_PATH#http://}"; REPO="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@${HOST_PATH}"; fi
if [[ -d .git ]]; then git remote set-url origin "${REPO}"; git fetch --all --prune; if [[ -n "${BRANCH:-}" ]]; then git checkout "${BRANCH}"; fi; git pull --ff-only; elif [[ -n "$(ls -A . 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then echo "ERROR: Directory is not empty and not a Git repository; refusing overwrite."; exit 10; else if [[ -n "${BRANCH:-}" ]]; then git clone --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${REPO}" .; else git clone "${REPO}" .; fi; fi
if [[ -f package.json ]]; then npm install --omit=dev; fi
echo "Node.js application files prepared."

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: Optional Git repository URL. Leave blank for uploaded files.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Optional branch; blank uses repository default.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: Set to 1 to skip Git cloning and use panel-uploaded files.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull Git changes on startup when using a Git clone.

variables.name: Main File
variables.description: Entrypoint such as index.js, bot.js, or src/index.ts.

variables.name: Additional Node Packages
variables.description: Optional npm packages separated by spaces.

variables.name: Uninstall Node Packages
variables.description: Optional npm packages to remove, separated by spaces.

variables.name: Node Arguments
variables.description: Optional arguments passed to the entrypoint.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Optional private Git token; keep secret.
